ja: • 伝説のポケモン「ゼルネアス」「イベルタル」がセットになって登場。
• 「セルネアス」のポケプラアクションは、見上げる、角をつき出す、かけまわる。
• 「イベルタル」のポケプラアクションは、口を開けて叫ぶ、足を動かす、羽ばたく。
成形品×6、ホイルシール×2、組立説明書×1
en: • The legendary Pokemon "Xerneas" and "Yveltal" are now available as a set.
• "Cerneas"'s Pokepla actions include looking up, sticking out its horns, and running around.
• "Yveltal"'s Pokepla actions include opening his mouth and shouting, moving his legs, and flapping his wings.
Molded product x 6, foil seal x 2, assembly manual x 1
